title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star
text:
Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star is a short song. Children sing it at home and at school. The song is about a little star in the sky.

The star is very bright at night. Many children like to count the stars. Some children learn the song when they are very young.

options: A little star in the sky
A big dog in the park

questions.text: When do some children learn the song?
Why do children probably enjoy the song?
options: It is simple and easy to sing
It is very long and hard
It is sung in a foreign language

questions.text: What can we infer about the star in the song?
options: It is far away and shines at night

vocabulary.definition: giving out a lot of light
to say numbers in order to find how many there are
to make music with your voice
having lived for only a short time

paragraph_translations: Пісня «Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star» коротка. Діти співають її вдома та в школі. Вона розповідає про маленьку зірку на небі.
Зірка дуже яскрава вночі. Багато дітей люблять рахувати зірки. Деякі діти вивчають цю пісню, коли вони ще зовсім малі.
